images.title: How the June average is made
images.purpose: Shows four Junes of rainfall and their average, 850 millimetres.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Four vertical bars in a row with one dashed horizontal line across them.
images.exact_structure: Four vertical teal (#0072B2) bars of equal width standing on one baseline, heights in proportion to 820, 900, 760 and 920; each bar has its value on top: 820, 900, 760, 920. One dashed reddish purple (#CC79A7) horizontal line crosses all four bars at height 850, with the tag average 850 mm at its right end. Under the baseline, the caption June, 4 years. No vertical axis numbers.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The monthly average is a typical June, found by adding the Junes and dividing by the number of years.
images.description: Shows four Junes of rainfall and their average, 850 millimetres.
images.context: Rainfall in millimetres over four years: 820 + 900 + 760 + 920 = 3400; 3400 divided by 4 is 850.

image_decisions.why: The dashed line shows the average as the level that evens out the four Junes.
